purpose: Say that a state continues or completion is pending.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
まだ + affirmative; まだ + negative.
I have not had lunch yet.
I have not finished my homework yet.
formation: まだ + affirmative; まだ + negative.
restrictions: An affirmative often means still; a negative often means not yet.
mistake: Choose the predicate’s polarity to match the intended meaning.
